Acros#0.visual_notes: Black-and-white images with strong contrast and the distinctive tonal character of Acros — deep shadows, clean highlights, and subtle grain. Subject matter leans heavily toward arid desert landscapes of the American Southwest, minimalist compositions with expansive skies, and detailed natural textures of forests and trees. Light is often harsh and midday, lending a graphic, high-clarity quality with strong, defined lines.

Acros#1.visual_notes: Black-and-white images with soft midtones and delicate highlight and shadow rendering, characteristic of the Acros simulation. Light is often diffused or backlit, producing silhouettes, flares, and graphic shadows falling across walls. Typical subjects include urban architecture, street details, nature, and understated portraits with a subdued, slightly matte tonality.

Classic Chrome#0.visual_notes: Images are defined by a warm, slightly muted color palette with the reduced saturation and gentle contrast typical of Classic Chrome. Light is predominantly natural — golden hour or soft diffused daylight — with an emphasis on greens, ochres, and warm red-orange tones. Common subjects include natural scenes, flowers, backlit foliage, and quiet landscapes, all carrying a retro film character.

Classic Chrome#1.visual_notes: Images feature soft, muted colors with a warm earthy cast characteristic of the Classic Chrome film simulation. Light is often gentle, with a golden-hour or hazy quality, shadows are clean, and contrast is moderate. Typical subjects include natural landscapes, autumn foliage, children's portraits, and street scenes — all carrying a vintage tone and a slightly faded look.

subjects: close-up of a branch with berries
city view from a tower window
retro pickup truck on the street
Classic Chrome#2.visual_notes: The images feature a muted, slightly faded palette with an emphasis on warm earthy tones and rich blue skies. Lighting is predominantly soft daylight, with a retro film look characterized by a subtle matte quality and reduced shadow contrast. Typical subjects include American suburbs, nature, vintage objects, and street scenes in the spirit of classic slide film.

Classic Chrome#3.visual_notes: The images feature a faded, muted color palette with warm pinkish-brown and dusty green tones, emulating aged Elite Chrome film with a fading effect. Lighting is often soft and low-contrast, with subdued shadows and slightly lifted blacks. Typical subjects include industrial railway scenes, suburban America, nature, and floral close-ups, all carrying a subtle retro melancholy.

Classic Negative#0.visual_notes: The images feature a muted vintage palette with warm earthy tones, soft blue skies, and restrained contrast characteristic of Classic Negative. Lighting is predominantly natural — ranging from bright midday sun to dramatic sunsets and overcast haze — lending the shots a nostalgic, cinematic film atmosphere. Typical subjects include small-town American architecture, natural and coastal landscapes, and close-up plant shots with soft bokeh.

Classic Negative#1.visual_notes: The images are characterized by a muted, slightly flat color rendering with the warm highlights and cool shadows typical of Classic Negative. Light is often soft and golden in sunset and sunny shots, with a subtle reduction in contrast and a vintage feel. Natural scenes, retro details, and urban subjects predominate, all carrying a nostalgic, film-like atmosphere.

subjects: retro diner with car on the roof
Classic Negative#2.visual_notes: The images feature a warm, golden tonality with muted, slightly faded colors and the soft contrast characteristic of classic negative film. Light is often low and directional — sunset or backlit — casting a warm glow across foliage, snow, and architecture. Scenes range from desolate winter landscapes to cozy nighttime city shots, all tied together by a retro mood and a natural, subtly nostalgic palette.

subjects: wooden post with chain by the water
person with camera in the forest
Classic Negative#3.visual_notes: The images are defined by a muted, faded palette with warm earthy and greenish tones characteristic of the Classic Negative film simulation. Light is soft and diffused, with a misty haze over landscapes and low contrast in the shadows. Typical subjects include foggy autumn scenery, natural details, architecture, and quiet waterside scenes, all carrying a nostalgic, analog mood.

subjects: nature and flowers near a house
portrait of a child on a playground
Eterna Bleach Bypass#0.visual_notes: The photos feature a muted, slightly desaturated palette with a distinctive bleach bypass effect — reduced saturation, increased contrast, and dark silvery shadows. The light is soft, often with a warm faded tone shifting into cool, washed-out skies. Typical subjects include urban and rural architecture, natural landscapes, portraits, and still life shots with a vintage, documentary feel.

Eterna Bleach Bypass#1.visual_notes: The photos feature a muted, desaturated palette with cool blue shadows while preserving the richness of pink and red accents. The light is contrasty, with deep shadows and flat highlights that create a cinematic bleach bypass effect. Typical subjects include Spanish architecture, bougainvillea blossoms against the sky, railway scenes, and street shots with a subdued dramatic quality.

Eterna#0.visual_notes: The photos have a soft, filmic quality with muted, slightly faded colors and warm golden light, particularly in backlit scenes. Subdued greens, beiges, and earthy tones dominate, with pleasing bokeh and low shadow contrast. Typical subjects include nature, desert landscapes of the American Southwest, Spanish Colonial architecture, and cozy indoor still lifes in natural light.

subjects: close-up flowers (geraniums, roses, lilacs, cherry blossoms)
portrait in front of a mural
Eterna#1.visual_notes: The images have a soft, low-contrast look with muted, slightly faded colors and the distinctive cinematic palette of Eterna. Shadows are deep but not crushed, highlights are restrained, and the overall tone leans toward warm earthy and dusty green hues with a nostalgic film character. Typical subjects include city streets, vintage objects, nature and flowers, and night scenes with cool light and warm accents.

Eterna#2.visual_notes: The images feature a muted cinematic palette with cool teal-green shadows and warm golden-amber highlights. The tonal rendering is soft, with reduced contrast and slightly faded highlights characteristic of the Eterna film simulation. Typical subjects include evening and nighttime urban scenes, nature in diffused light, and interiors with warm light sources.

PRO Neg#1.visual_notes: The images have a soft, muted color rendition with warm, slightly faded tones reminiscent of analog film. Light is mostly soft and diffused, contrast is moderate with a gentle shadow lift (chrome bypass), and colors are understated and pastel. Typical subjects include everyday still lifes, nature, urban details, and portraits with a retro mood.

PRO Neg#2.visual_notes: The photos feature soft, muted colors with a slight cool blue-green shift in the skies and warm pastel tones on surfaces. The light is bright and daylit, but contrast is restrained, creating a vintage film atmosphere with a nostalgic character. Typical scenes include California suburban America: gas stations, palm trees, retro signage, brick architecture, and nature under a faded sky.

PRO Neg#3.visual_notes: The photos feature soft, muted color rendering with warm earthy tones and pastel hues characteristic of negative film. The light is mostly diffused or soft golden hour, with reduced contrast and gentle transitions. Typical scenes include autumn nature with yellow and red foliage, forest trails, streams, and urban architecture in warm evening light.

PRO Neg#4.visual_notes: The photos feature soft, muted tones with warm golden and pastel hues characteristic of negative film. The light is often diffused or backlit, with gentle shadow-to-highlight transitions and reduced saturation. Natural and coastal scenes predominate, with a subtle haze that lends a calm and gently nostalgic mood.

Velvia.visual_notes: The photos feature deep, saturated colors with an emphasis on lush greens, vivid blue skies, and warm red-orange tones, all characteristic of the Velvia simulation. Contrast is high, shadows are dense, and the color palette can lean into strong shifts — greens and magentas in night and urban shots. Typical scenes include dramatic natural landscapes, retro subjects with textured patina, and close-up plant detail.

Monochrome.visual_notes: Black-and-white shots with a rich tonal range — from deep, saturated shadows to soft, bright skies. Light is often backlit and graphic, with silhouettes of foliage and branches standing out expressively against overcast skies. Scenes range from natural landscapes and waterfalls to street details and architecture, conveying a calm, documentary-contemplative mood.

Provia.visual_notes: These images are characterized by natural, neutral color rendering with soft, understated tones typical of the Provia film simulation. Light is mostly soft and diffused, with realistic color representation spanning warm sunset and autumn hues to cool winter scenes. Tonality is balanced and true-to-life, free from aggressive contrast, making it well suited to landscapes, portraits, and everyday street subjects alike.

Astia.visual_notes: These shots feature soft pastel color rendering with a warm bias and muted midtones characteristic of Astia. Some frames lean into strong red-pink redscale tones — particularly the mountain sunset scenes — while others retain clean blue skies and delicate pastel walls. Light is predominantly bright daylight, and compositions are often minimalist with large open expanses of sky.
